name: digest-pipeline-salesforce-slack
description: Digest quotidien du pipeline Salesforce vers Slack, workflows n8n

scripts.pull: for id in $npm_package_config_workflows; do n8ncli pull $id --skip-references || exit 1; done
scripts.push: for id in $npm_package_config_workflows; do n8ncli push $id || exit 1; done
scripts.status: for id in $npm_package_config_workflows; do n8ncli status $id || exit 1; done
